meta.name: Discharge Coordinator AI — Distractor Reference List
meta.definition: A detail that looks like a discharge problem but is actually fine. A careful system ignores it; flagging it is a false positive.
source_corrections: duplicate quick-lookup row for B-S07 merged
Source header says 140 phrases; groups A-F actually contain 126 (Group G holds prompt templates, not phrases).

usage_rules.no_overlap: A phrase may not be used if any of its avoid_if_barriers is in the case's barrier list.
usage_rules.theme_guidance: groups[].theme_avoid_barriers is advisory (the sheet's 'use when' line); phrases marked safe_with_all_barriers may still be used.
usage_rules.condition_fit: The case's condition must be in suitable_conditions.
usage_rules.copy_exactly: Phrases are inserted verbatim into the case's distractors field.
usage_rules.ai_generated_allowed: Group G templates may be used; check the output does not describe a real barrier.
usage_rules.precedence: Per-phrase avoid_if_barriers is authoritative; quick_lookup is a convenience guide.

groups.title: A test result that looked worrying but is now resolved
A medication detail that looks notable but is fine
A past medical history item that is resolved and has no current impact
A social or lifestyle detail that looks like a concern but is fine
A routine clinical check or procedure that is complete

templates.template: I am writing a synthetic hospital discharge case for a research dataset. The patient has [CONDITION NAME] and the real discharge barriers already in this case are: [LIST YOUR BARRIER LABELS IN PLAIN ENGLISH, e.g., 'medication reconciliation incomplete, follow-up not scheduled']. Write me one short sentence, under 30 words, describing a small medical detail about this patient that looks notable but is actually resolved and fine. Do not describe anything related to the barriers I listed. Write only the sentence, nothing else.

templates.purpose: For a social or logistical distractor
templates.template: I am writing a synthetic hospital discharge case for a research dataset. The patient has [CONDITION NAME] and already has these discharge barriers: [LIST YOUR BARRIER LABELS]. Write me one sentence describing a social or personal detail about this patient that initially looks like it could be a concern but turns out to be fine and not a barrier to discharge. Under 30 words. Write only the sentence.

templates.purpose: If you need two distractors (for hard cases)
templates.template: I am writing a hard synthetic hospital discharge case for a research dataset. The patient has [CONDITION NAME] and already has these discharge barriers: [LIST YOUR BARRIER LABELS]. Write me exactly two short sentences. Each sentence describes a different detail about this patient that looks notable but is actually fine and resolved. The two details should be about different topics (for example, one clinical and one social). Each sentence under 30 words. Write only the two sentences, nothing else.
